scientific_target: Prospectively identify matched source-origin pairs in shared transplant gardens that are similar in current climate yet contrasting in 21ka-to-0BP climate history, before any fitness response is opened.

modern_matched_historical_contrasts.rule: Within original study×species×transplant-garden×fitness-type, select two different source IDs with distinct original geographic coordinates; 4-D current source climate distance <=1.0 source training SD units AND absolute difference in scalar LGM/current displacement magnitude >=0.5 source training H SD units.
modern_matched_historical_contrasts.counting_warning: The 160,205 source-pair combinations, 29,867 threshold-matched combinations and 10,255 deduplicated keys are correlated combinations of the same populations, studies and gardens; NONE is an independent biological replicate count.

residual_historical_information.unit: Source H within exact study×taxon×garden×performance-type cell; cell intercept absorbed; current source climate 4 variables, source latitude/longitude and source-garden great-circle distance are 7 linear controls.
residual_historical_information.note: 60.12% is *predictor residual variance*, not variance in plant fitness explained, causal adaptation, Haldane rate, or ecological selection. Assumes simple linear baseline; nonlinear redundancy and concentration remain unchecked.

frozen_qualification.not_permitted: Do not lower total species threshold, choose a weaker historical contrast threshold, mix arthropod/fungus records back in, switch to another climate norm, choose favorite fitness type or append overlapping source papers to rescue.
